caveats.injuries: Injury report from the league's official practice reports via nflverse: shown, not applied. The model reads only who starts at quarterback.
caveats.lines: Model line and model total are the model's own numbers beside the market's. Taking the model's side against the closing spread won 49.8% of 2016-2025 games and against the total 50.1%; -110 needs 52.4% to break even.
caveats.model: The pick is the model blended with the betting market. The market is hard to beat in the NFL: across 2016-2025 the blend picked 66.4% of winners against the closing favourite's 66.6%, and betting the model where it disagreed with the price lost money. Treat a pick as an opinion with a measured hit rate, not an edge.
caveats.news: Headlines from public NFL news feeds that name one of the two teams or their players, published before kickoff. Shown, not applied.
caveats.players: Most valuable on offence is ranked by expected points added (EPA) this season - the points a player's plays added above an average play in the same situation; defenders by sacks, takeaways, passes defended and tackles for loss. A listed player who is out or doubtful - or the most valuable player questionable - is flagged at the top of the game, from the official injury report and the weekly roster. Shown, not applied: only the starting quarterback moves the pick.
caveats.props: Projected yards are the middle of what the player's recent usage and his team's expected points point to, if he plays. In 2020-2025: passing 56 yards off on average (his own average: 67); rushing 18 yards off on average (his own average: 18); receiving 18 yards off on average (his own average: 20). Players went over about half the time, as a middle number should. Shown, not applied.
caveats.qb: The quarterback the model assumes is the one the schedule projects to start. If the injury report says he is out, the number above does not know yet.
caveats.td: Chance of a rushing or receiving touchdown, if he plays - from his recent carries, targets and snaps and his team's expected points from the betting line. In 2020-2025 each team's most likely scorer scored 43.5% of the time (the model said 41.1%). Measured, and shown, not applied.
caveats.td_list: Every active QB, RB, FB, WR and TE is listed - everyone you can back to score. A chance is shown only where the model was measured as well calibrated: within 20% of what happened in both 2014-2019 and 2020-2025. Players with little use or no NFL game are listed with a dash instead. For players with no NFL game: it said 2.7% where 7.9% scored (2020-2025); under 0.5 weighted carries + targets a game: it said 3.7% where 2.7% scored (2020-2025); 0.5-1 weighted carries + targets a game: it said 6.2% where 4.9% scored (2014-2019).
caveats.td_meters: Two meters from the live record - touchdown picks logged before kickoff, games graded from the box score. TOP 3 -> SCORED: of the times a player was in his team's top three most likely touchdown scorers, how often he scored a rushing or receiving touchdown; a pick who did not play is left out, as every chance was if he plays. NOT TOP 3 -> NO TD: of the times a player played without being in that top three, how often he did not score. Where the whole list a bettor could back (every active QB, RB, FB, WR and TE) was logged before kickoff, 'not top 3' is the rest of that list who played. Games logged before that list was, with only the top three, rebuild 'not top 3' from the snap counts: every other player of the team who took an offensive snap at QB, RB, FB, WR or TE, his touchdowns from the box score (none if he has no box-score line).
caveats.tiers: STRONG, SOLID, LEAN and TOSS-UP are bands of the pick's probability. The percentage beside each is how often picks in that band won in 2016-2025 - measured, not promised.
caveats.value_off: No game is labelled a bet: backing the model where it disagreed with the closing moneyline did not make money in 2016-2025 at any edge tested.

by_usage.rule: mean chance within 20% of the scoring rate and log loss under the position base rate, in 2014-2019 and in 2020-2025, on at least 200 rows each

track_record.basis: one pick per game, the last one logged before kickoff
